licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (ei toglie, where the libretto has che toglie; in catena as two words, where the libretto has incatena; quì; fa without an apostrophe; anch' io as two words). The printed slips “sc” (bar 46, for se) and “t'empic” (bar 59, for t'empie) are kept as printed.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 287–291, bars 1–113 of No. 28
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung line and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (in two page ranges, pp. 287–289 and 290–291), a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The German singing translation is left out. Bar 1 is a one-eighth upbeat, set as 1/8; bars 108–113 are for the piano alone. Kept as printed: the misprinted syllables “sc” (bar 46, for se) and “pic” (bar 59, for pie). The cut signs at “vi-” (bars 33 and 80) and “-de” (bars 64 and 92) are not written in the score. Playback tempo: Allegretto vivace at a dotted quarter = 72 (♩ = 109), from Jacobs (3:07); Mozart gives the words only.
